sections.introduction: Ashwagandhadi Lehyam is a very famous herbal jam. It is also known as Ashwagandhadi Lehyam, Ashwagandhadi Lehyam. This Ayurvedic product is a very effective body building supplement. It helps to gain weight in a healthy way. It is used in the problems like muscle weakness, low body weight, etc.
sections.ingredients:
Ashwagandha – Withania somnifera – 192 g

 Sariva – Hemidesmus indicus – 192 g 
 Shweta Jiraka – White caraway – 192 g 
 Madhusnuhi – Smilax china – 192 g 

 Method of Preparation 

 A Kashayam (decoction) is prepared by mixing all the above mentioned ingredients. 
 1.256 kg of sugar is added to this and heating is continued. 
 Meanwhile, raisins – 192 grams are taken and slightly heated with 226 grams of ghee. This paste is also added to mixture. 
 Heating is continued till the whole mass gains jam consistency. 
 Then it is added with 24 grams of cardamom, stirred well. 
 At the end, 452 grams of honey is added.
sections.dosage:
Take 5 – 10 grams once or twice a day before or after food with milk, or as directed by Ayurvedic Doctor. 
 Dosage for children below 5 years of age : 1-2 grams, once or twice a day, along with a teaspoon of honey or warm water / milk. 
 Dosage for children between 5-12 years of age : 5 grams once or twice a day along with a teaspoon of honey or warm water / milk.

Ashwagandhadi Lehyam – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Introduction 
 Ashwagandhadi Lehyam is a very famous herbal jam. It is also known as Ashwagandhadi Lehyam, Ashwagandhadi Lehyam. This Ayurvedic product is a very effective body building supplement. It helps to gain weight in a healthy way. It is used in the problems like muscle weakness, low body weight, etc. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Ashwagandha – Withania somnifera – 192 g
 
 Sariva – Hemidesmus indicus – 192 g 
 Shweta Jiraka – White caraway – 192 g 
 Madhusnuhi – Smilax china – 192 g 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 
 A Kashayam (decoction) is prepared by mixing all the above mentioned ingredients. 
 1.256 kg of sugar is added to this and heating is continued. 
 Meanwhile, raisins – 192 grams are taken and slightly heated with 226 grams of ghee. This paste is also added to mixture. 
 Heating is continued till the whole mass gains jam consistency. 
 Then it is added with 24 grams of cardamom, stirred well. 
 At the end, 452 grams of honey is added. 
 
 Dosage 
 Take 5 – 10 grams once or twice a day before or after food with milk, or as directed by Ayurvedic Doctor. 
 Dosage for children below 5 years of age : 1-2 grams, once or twice a day, along with a teaspoon of honey or warm water / milk. 
 Dosage for children between 5-12 years of age : 5 grams once or twice a day along with a teaspoon of honey or warm water / milk. 
 Indications 
 
 Fights fatigue 
 Powerful aphrodisiac 
 Improves muscle strength 
 Tiredness 
 Keeps optimum energy levels 
 Improving digestive and respiratory health. 
 Relieves emaciation 
 Blood impurities 
 
 Side Effects 
 
 There are no known side effects with this product. 
 This medicine should be avoided in diabetic patients as it contains sugar. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
